name: BytePlus Cloud Sandbox
description: On-demand Volcengine ECS cloud sandbox backend for OpenClaw agents. Automatically provisions VPC, security group, and SSH key pair on first use — only `image` is required.

image.description: Container image to run (e.g. cr.volces.com/my-org/sandbox:latest). Defaults to cr.volces.com/openclaw/sandbox:latest.

remoteWorkspaceDir.description: Working directory inside the instance. Default: /workspace.

containerPrefix.description: Prefix for ECS instance names. Default: openclaw-sbx-.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for instance startup. Default: 180.

idleHours.description: Delete instances idle for this many hours. Default: 24. Set 0 to disable.

maxAgeDays.description: Delete instances older than this many days. Default: 7. Set 0 to disable.

vpcId.description: Optional: pre-existing VPC ID. If omitted, auto-detected or created on first use.

subnetId.description: Optional: pre-existing subnet ID. If omitted, auto-detected or created on first use.

securityGroupId.description: Optional: pre-existing security group ID. If omitted, auto-created with SSH inbound rule.

keyPairName.description: Optional: pre-existing key pair name registered in Volcengine. If omitted, auto-generated.

sshPrivateKey.description: Optional: PEM private key string for SSH. If omitted, auto-generated and cached locally.

providerAuthEnvVars.name: BYTEPLUS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
providerAuthEnvVars.label: BytePlus Access Key ID
providerAuthEnvVars.description: Volcengine Access Key ID. Also accepts VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

providerAuthEnvVars.name: BYTEPLUS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
providerAuthEnvVars.label: BytePlus Secret Access Key
providerAuthEnvVars.description: Volcengine Secret Access Key. Also accepts VOLCENGINE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
